Eden: Originating RC for tokenizer/backpressure fix. RC id: pegasus-5901. Holding a 25m quiet window. Can someone run a fast smoke and give RM ack?

deploy-bot: Candidate created: pegasus-5901 | image: registry.redwood/serve:sha256:bb77ee99 | pinned=true | start canary: `/deploy promote pegasus-5901 --to=canary --traffic=5%`

Ravi: Ack. Starting smoke + perf quickscan. Will post failures.

Nora: Infra precheck: GPUs reserved, PV mounts ok, autoscaler quotas fine. KV cache prefetch scheduled +1m after canary start.

Ravi: smoke results: PASS (30 queries). p50 down ~8ms, no errors. sample: `200 OK` across pods.

Eden: Abort conditions: sustained 3m error rate >0.8% OR p95 latency jump > 150ms. Rollback snippet for release notes:
```bash
# rollback to previous stable
/deploy rollback promo-5901001 --to=stable
# unpin image
/gcr unpin registry.redwood/serve:sha256:bb77ee99
```

Olga: RM conditional signoff: approve staged promotion if 25% is stable for 20m with no quality regressions on sampled outputs.

deploy-bot: Queued action: `/deploy start pegasus-5901 --traffic=5% --kv-warm=true`

SRE-Bot: Quiet window engaged for 25m. Suppressing noisy alerts but keeping critical ones.

Eden: Starting ramp plan: 5% -> 25% over 12m if green. Promotion command when ready: `/deploy promote pegasus-5901 --to=prod --staged "25%:12m" --note "tokenizer/backpressure"`

Ravi: 15m update: 25% ramp completed, telemetry stable. Dash -> https://dashboards.internal/rc/5901

Nora: Observability: CPU/mem unchanged, error rate flat. No new SLO alerts.

Olga: RM final: signoff given. Ready for full lift in next maintenance window. I'll add release notes: "Tokenizer/backpressure fix; median latency improved; KV prefetch enabled."

Eden: Thanks all — publishing release notes and scheduling full-lift.
